description: ThoughtFox shared Renovate preset — public mirror. Source of truth is thoughtfox-ai/FoxKit packages/config/renovate/default.json (private); this file is copied here, verbatim, so repos outside the thoughtfox-ai org can extend it. Extend with github>thoughtfox-ai/renovate-config. Do not edit this file directly — edit FoxKit's copy and re-sync.

packageRules.description: Automerge PATCH updates only, once CI is green. Switch to patch+minor after 2026-10-26 (plan decision: patch only for the first month, then patch and minor). Majors always wait for a human.
Minor and major updates never automerge (until 2026-10-26 for minor, forever for major).
Framework group: Next.js, React and Tailwind move together in one PR per app, never half an upgrade (plan §4.8 gate 3).
Framework majors wait 14 days after release (plan §4.8 gate 1).

Radix UI primitives move together: mismatched @radix-ui/* versions inside one app are a common source of subtle breakage, and FoxKit's own @thoughtfox-ai/ui uses the unified radix-ui package. Found repeated across StratOps, FlowFox, FamilyOps, elevAIte and others (2026-09-27 scan).
dnd-kit's core/sortable/utilities packages are versioned as one unit; update together to avoid drag-and-drop breaking silently. Found in FamilyOps, StratOps, elevAIte, FlowFox (2026-09-27 scan).
BlockNote's core/react/mantine packages must match versions or the editor breaks. Found in FamilyOps, StratOps, FlowFox (2026-09-27 scan).

TanStack and Zustand: the shared app-level data and state layer, grouped to cut PR noise (they don't have to move together, but repos almost always bump them at the same time). Found in FamilyOps, StratOps, FlowFox, elevAIte (2026-09-27 scan).

Supabase client packages, grouped so ssr and supabase-js stay compatible. Found in nearly every app (2026-09-27 scan). Note: this is the raw @supabase/* npm packages, not FoxKit's own future @thoughtfox-ai/supabase package (that one is in the security-sensitive rule below).
Test tooling, grouped to cut PR noise; low risk since it never ships to users. Found in most apps (2026-09-27 scan).
Forms and validation move together: react-hook-form's resolvers are versioned against specific zod ranges. Found in nearly every app (2026-09-27 scan).
The rest of the shadcn/ui utility belt that isn't Radix itself, grouped to cut PR noise. Found across StratOps, FlowFox, FamilyOps, elevAIte and others (2026-09-27 scan).
FoxKit packages: grouped, so one FoxKit release is one PR per app.
Majors of anything get a clear label.

Security-sensitive FoxKit packages get their own PR, are NEVER automerged at any update level, and always need a human review (plan §4.6 stricter rules). Keep this rule LAST among the automerge rules so nothing re-enables automerge.
